# Languages {.unnumbered}

{{< include _versions.qmd >}}

The language table by langID.

```{r setup, echo=FALSE}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath("../"))
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Source utility functions
source("R/qmd-utils.R")
# Source table formatting
source("R/format-table.R")
source("R/odm-dictionary-file.R")
source("R/languages-sheet.R")

# Read in and prepare languages data.frame
languages_table_source <-
  readxl::read_excel(file.path(getwd(),odm_dictionary$dictionary_directory, dictionary_full_file_name),
                     sheet = odm_dictionary$languages_sheet_name, .name_repair = "unique_quiet")
languages_table <- format_table(languages_table_source, languages_sheet_column_names, strip_invalid_part_ID = FALSE)



output_string <- ""

# Loop over rows and create outputs per row
for (row_index in seq_len(nrow(languages_table))) {
  languages_table_row <- languages_table[row_index, ]
  
  #Assumed to be valid and present
  lang <- languages_table_row[[languages$lang$name]]

  lang_fam <- languages_table_row[[languages$lang_fam$name]]
  lang_name <- languages_table_row[[languages$lang_name$name]]
  natName <- languages_table_row[[languages$natName$name]]
  code_1 <- languages_table_row[[languages$iso6391$name]]
  code_3 <- languages_table_row[[languages$iso6392T$name]]
  firstReleased	 <- languages_table_row[[languages$firstReleased$name]]
  lastUpdated <- languages_table_row[[languages$lastUpdated$name]]
  changes <- languages_table_row[[languages$changes$name]]
  notes <- languages_table_row[[languages$notes$name]]

  # Verify display elements
  verify_input(lang_fam,
               glue::glue('Language family is missing for {lang}'))
  verify_input(lang_name,
               glue::glue('Language name is missing for {lang}'))
  verify_input(code_1,
               glue::glue('{languages$iso6391$name} is missing for {lang}'))
  verify_input(code_3,
               glue::glue('{languages$iso6392T$name} is missing for {lang}'))

  # Construct the print
  output_string <- glue::glue('{output_string}

                              # {natName}({lang})
                              Language Family: {lang_fam}  
                              Language name: {lang_name}  
                              ISO639-1 code: {code_1} 
                              ISO639-2T code:	{code_3}  
                              First released version: {firstReleased}
                              Last updated version: {lastUpdated}
                              Changes column: {changes}
                              Notes: {notes}')
}


```

`r output_string`
